reviews.title: Normal but messy flight
reviews.text: The flight was just normal flight,normal on any other way but some children was sick and throw up in plain....it was not cleaned un till we lending in Tenerife
reviews.author: Sanfran B

reviews.title: Absolutely horrid! Will never fly this airline again.
reviews.text: Leaving from London, my flight was delayed by a solid 5 hours. Not enough legroom (even for a petite person like me), rude service, ugly blaringly bright yellow and blue motif, in short: everything that's terrible about Ryan Air, but take that horrible quality, double it by two and do the same for delay + flight time. A nightmare.
reviews.author: woolyd

reviews.title: BEWARE the owner of this company is still in business
reviews.text: Our flight was booked the September 27th (that's right : 3 days before Primera Air declared bankruptcy). As most people, once I got the confirmation e-mail, it was all set for me. I did not go back to check "if the airline company I booked with still in business". How many people actually do that ? You know you booked it, you move on and do other things while the trip is approaching. I would have expect an email / call / SMS saying "your flight have been cancelled, sorry but we're out of business". Things can get ugly, stuff like that can happen but at least have the courage to tell your customers what you've done so they can find a solution. Even if there are basically zero chances they'll ever get a refund from you. But don't leave everyone stranded with a lame "sorry" on your Facebook page and no way to contact your company anymore (by email or phone) because all your employees lost their jobs too. Even with little chances to get our money back, knowing on October the 2nd about it would have allow us to buy another ticket and to organise. But it was meant to happen otherwise. We did find out : the same day of the departure (in December), just before going to the airport. What about other people who booked their trips and (like us) don't even know yet there's no airplane to take them home for Christmas ? Needless to describe the shock and the amount of money we had to spend for another plane ticket leaving the same day. At least we could do something : other customers found themselves at the airport with family, small children and little or no possibility to spend again for a trip already paid. At my biggest astonishment I have found out the owner of Primera Air was Mrs Andri M. Ingolfsson who is now the proud chairman and owner of "TravelCo Nordic" managing 7 tour operators based in the Nordics. This is part of Primera Group as described on their official website. While he didn't find useful to inform the passengers of Primera Air about the bankruptcy situation, his website claims "strong values and great dedication" to customers. Sure : give them your money, they'll know how to make good use of it and by the way, forget about the service you paid for in case they don't know how to manage their finances. I hope this is useful at least for one person who considered buying or heard about TravelCo Nordic and knows from now on these people are just as unreliable as Primera Air was and it is a huge risk to pay even a dollar to such a company. As for everybody else who is struggling because of this situation created by Primera Air : be brave and even if you don't get your money back, do not leave this to ruin your life / vacation / self-esteem etc. Primera Air already got your cash, they do not deserve your energy nor your tears. Choose to learn something from this situation and move on, choosing your attitude it's the only thing you have left to do.
reviews.author: Voyageur

reviews.title: TOTAL SCAM - they hold money and then cancel flights.  CRIMINALS
reviews.text: They cancelled my flight the day I was supposed to leave and then said they would refund cost of flight and cost of new ticket. The new ticket cost me a fortune to book day of and they NEVER REFUNDED me. Now taking legal action against them and they are in Copenhagen, what to do?
reviews.author: Phil T

reviews.title: Owed thousands of dollars from this company
reviews.text: They owe me over $5000 in replacement flights as they cancelled our flight day of and promised that they would reimburse us $1500 per person. We will never be seeing that money back now.
reviews.author: Angelique N

reviews.title: Mr Kayani
reviews.text: It was very sad to hear that Primera Air is no more in the Air Industry.we travelled from USA to London. The Air line got a new Airbus321. Very good service Very clean Nice staff.
reviews.author: bak78769

reviews.title: Took the Last Flight fron London to Newark Sept.30, 2018
reviews.text: Their transatlantic schedule matched when we could travel. But they are no longer operating. We had a good travel experience but I did lose sleep after booking this flight due to the late delivery of their new aircraft to service their transatlantic routes and also other TripAdvisor reviewers reporting difficulties obtaining refunds for cancelled and delayed flights.
reviews.author: Michael L

reviews.title: Direct flight from Wash DC!
reviews.text: It's too bad Primera Air is gone. Its a direct flight from Washington Dulles Airport, clean, on schedule, and very reasonably priced.
reviews.author: Genie D

reviews.title: Stupid Airlines
reviews.text: This is the worst airlines I have experienced in my past 10 years of travelling history. They have stolen my money and not refunding for the canceled flight. I could not fly because of the maintenance of their plane. Don’t buy even a short trip ticket from primera air
reviews.author: Isbandiyar H

reviews.title: Plain airline
reviews.text: The airplane has no TV screen. No movies or no films. Make sure to bring your entertainment with you. the seats are leather but stiff. No soft cushiony seats. Expect to be charged for anything you ask for, including soft drinks and water. They have few choices of food on the airplane but if you want warm dinner, you better order when making the reservation. As far as carry on, they allow up to 10kg. they will ask you to put all your carry-ons on the scale. Another issue is no online check-in. Need to go to the counter to get your boarding pass.
reviews.author: Vram J

reviews.title: Horrible - No notice on the bankruptcy whatsoever
reviews.text: I travelled early in the morning from Sweden to Copenhagen airport to find out that Primera Air had gone bankrupt only last week. They had not sent me ANY information on this what so ever. No email. No text message. No phone call. Now there is no information on how to contact them to get the money back. And I had all car rentals, hotels and other things booked for my vacation. HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE.
reviews.author: mikoMS

reviews.title: Sad to hear airline has gone into Administration
reviews.text: We travelled in September with Primera Airlines. It was not possible to check in online with this airline but apart form this the whole process was straightforward without any issues or delays. The plane was functional, no thrills but the stewards and stewardess were really nice and friendly unlike some flights i've been on. I was sad to hear they have since gone in to administration.
reviews.author: Terry F

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We waited in boarding lounge for at least 45 mins before plane even landed stood and waited for another hour for passengers to get of plane then another hour for plane to be cleaned so we could finally board!! Flight was ok when it finally happened! Was dubious about this company to start with even more so when our flight was cancelled and then rearranged eventually! Disappointing but predictable that they have gone bust!!
reviews.author: Lisa F

reviews.title: PURE EVIL
reviews.text: Still waiting on our reimbursement since our cancelled flight due to 'technical difficulties' in the first week of July. We have a written agreement from them that we will have our reimbursement of 3031,82 EUR by 18th of September but have not heard from them since. We have spent £3450 on new travel and £600 on the original flights with Primera and have not got a penny back. They have now gone into administration and declared bankrupt. We are taking on legal action and someone will pay for it. I am a final year University student and this is money from a years worth of savings for my house deposit so you can empathise how stressful this situation has been for me.
reviews.author: Paulina

reviews.title: Look at my previous review, this was just a matter of time
reviews.text: To all those giving this airline 5 stars, I am glad it worked out for you. My reviews typically are positive and I try to steer travelers towards places where the dollar goes far and the service and/or product is exceptional. In the negative cases I try to save travelers some headaches. This was the case here. I consider myself lucky, I got my money back. When one of my flights was canceled I got on the website and called customer service. It was at this moment I knew I was not dealing with a legit business so instead of rebooking I asked for all my money back, while waiting on hold for 2 hours. I even asked the agent to email me a confirmation of our transaction. Bottom line, if it smells bad it may be bad. I tried to warn everybody.
reviews.author: Joe B

reviews.title: Frist Primera air experience
reviews.text: 1.Flight was 1:30 hrs late living Toronto. Affect a bite my plan. But stuff like that happened all the time. For my return flights we arrive 30minuite before. For schedule/time I give the a B+ 2. They quality of the service at the counter in Toronto was really professional. But In London they way the do thing is a bite of waist of time. You do the line 2 time one for primera "security check" and after that you do the line again for checking. Also it's seem they can really see what you actually book. I buy 2 extra luggages, the guy at the counter couldn't see it and ask for my receipt. If you don't have internet or didn't print it. Could be a problem. Counter service (Toronto A) /( London B) 3.the plain : the chair are okay confortables not the best but you will survive a 9h flight. A lot of leg space (really important when you tall). USB charge for you phone.WC are clean. Crew on the plane are okay didn't interact much with them. I give them a A verall for a low cost company primera air is one of the best base in my experience
reviews.author: Jl Y

reviews.title: A very lucky escape!!!!
reviews.text: Well, it doesn't matter anymore, as the airline has gone bust, but it is worth to say how lucky we were, as we flew with one of their last flights. The aircraft arrived 1 hour delayed and after boarding was completed and doors were closed, Captain informed us that the aircraft APU (Auxiliary power unit) was out of order. Air ground starter arrived but failed and another one came from another company. Engine no 1 started on the stand, we were pushed back, but engine no 2 never started, so back to that stand and later back to the terminal !!!!! After an hour or so, back to the aircraft, same story with the air ground starter and it finally worked. All in all we were delayed almost 4 hours and when we landed in BLL we were told the news. If the problem was not resolved, we would be stuck in CHQ and we should purchase new tickets and of course arrange and pay for our accommodation.
reviews.author: Christos M

reviews.title: flying across the atlantic on an empty stomac.
reviews.text: Booked our flight with Hahn air (an obscure plateform that sells tickets online, where you dont know with who you are flying with, but they do have a menu where you can choose seats, food etc...) Anyway. Traveling as a family, two adults and one newborn, ordered vegan food during reservation, because we are vegan, and got nothing during the flight, the staff was helpful and tried to feed us but everything proposed to us was non vegan. So thumbs down primera, hahn air, and all these low cost companies, because they will cost your life. Primera: , get a stock of food for everyone just in case, even if we had money to buy their vegan meal they did not have it. We made it alive to Toronto with a toddler on a empty stomac and if you have 300 cad or euro extra to spend on a better airline with the whole shabang just do it you only live once, prep some sandwich , prep an ipod full of movies cuz they aint got none. adios.
reviews.author: joakim P

reviews.title: Air travel from the medieval ages
reviews.text: I’ve never seen long international flights that last 7h to be without any sort of entertainment on board. I searched for that TV several times... There was none. WHAT? Yep, no TV. Moreover, meals not included either! WHAT?! Yes, you read that correctly too. Even for water we had to pay. None of the preheat passengers knew in advance that we would have such a bad deal, so be aware! I felt like a 3rd class citizen. Never again. Highly unrecommended!
reviews.author: adriana s

reviews.title: Great Budget Airline
reviews.text: I used this airline for my flight from London to Boston a couple of days ago. I had a great experience. First of all they didn't charge anything for checking my luggage which was great cause Norwegian for example charged me $100. The flight was on time and we even arrived 40 min early. The flight attendants were very friendly. Overall I would use them again!
reviews.author: Jennifer H

reviews.title: Budget airline
reviews.text: I'm not surprised it's gone bust. I'm very lucky we flew with them a week today and all I'm thinking about is them poor people stranded. When we flew arrived at Stansted checked in all was normal, we got to the gates only to have an hour delay due to operations, they only announced the once never changed on the board so if you got the gate you would have been sitting wondering why we are not on the plane. I look out the window couldn't belive my eyes when I saw how small our plane was!! While we was waiting a hour later you could see they was only just putting our bags on the plane. We get on the plane to find out we paid £75 to upgrade our seats so we was is the isle on a 2 seater row chair to find out they wasn't the right seats even tho we paid extra for that, im a nervous flyer and I don't like to sit next to anyone, I sat in them anyway and wasn't moving. To my horror there was NO tv NO blanket NO pillow NO nothing! Now we didn't book our flights it was a present for our 30th birthday to go see family in the U.S so to fly on a 8 hour flight with nothing was horrible! There wasn't even a tv on the isle like the old days when they used to do that on shot flights, least you got the instruction safety leaflet and a sick bag. Economy isn't even the word more like stone age!!! You had to pay for a over priced sandwich & bottle of water, the seats was so uncomfortable and it was so cold my legs and hips are now 7 days back are still in pain. Tho I have to say it was very clean and had a charging point so if you had prepare your self least you could charge your things. So as we was about to fly the piolt comes on saying sorry for the hour delay this is due to that fact your captain is sick and I'm the replacement now for me you don't say stuff like that as I'm nervous that made the situation worse for me. Tho I have to say it's been one of the best landings and take of iv had. Coming home from USA I wasn't happy about going back on such a small cramped plane at check in they said did you want to upgrade for the extra leg room, food, drinks, ply we got to sit next to each other and no one else was worth it, but what sold it was the blanket. We paid for it by passed security on priority boarding so the way for that was a lot quicker then the stand que again that was worth it alone, we was the first to board and get our seat which the extra leg room foot rest was worth it. It did feel nice to be upgraded for once. The food and unlimited drinks was worth it too, we got a pillow, a goodie bag with a eye mask, socks, tooth brush, hairbrush. Again worth the money but the issue for me we upgraded got all that but still no tv no blanket! It was so cold both times. what was concern and iv never seen this was the night flight home one of the pilot was sleeping I the chair infront of me, and the other pilot come out was having a drink. Now I thought they wasn't to leave cockpit at all times till they landed. Now looking back you can see why they gone bust, Tho after all that and if they hadn't gone bust I would have flown with them again and recommend them but would have made sure to bring a blanket along with my neck pillow my iPad with games, films on even my ds to keep me from being board. My review means nothing now but I thought I'd share my story
reviews.author: eyelight_angel

reviews.title: Good luck trying to get your money back
reviews.text: Since going into bankruptcy tonight, I had the misfortune of waiting 2 and a half hours to speak to someone to get a refund and gave up in the end. I’m fortunate enough that they cancelled my flight home and refunded me this back in May but I’ll be lucky to get the £350 for my flight to Toronto. The call centre staff I spoke to were helpful when I first spoke to them in May but this company is abysmal all round. I’ve never come across a company this shoddy and unprofessional before. I regret booking fights with them.
reviews.author: Harriet W

reviews.title: Great experience! Well.... Before they went bankrupt.
reviews.text: So let me preface this by saying how awful it is that the airline filed for bankruptcy leaving hundreds of people stranded and without compensation - and how lucky we JUST missed this. We must've been one of the last Toronto-Paris round-trips. We were excited at the prospect of such crazy cheap direct flights we randomly bought on a whim, and it wasn't until reading the reviews on here and reddit did my hopes sink a little bit about sudden flight cancelations. Checking the flight history online however showed no issues for this particular route - in fact, statistically arriving earlier! There was no online check-in or kiosks at YYZ nor at CDG (both Terminal 3) so everyone's stuck waiting in line. We bought Comfort tickets for the extra checked bag which ended up being very handy if not excessive. The gates at the airport on both ends needed shuttle busses to get to and wait for, and took a good 20 minute ride to eventually board the planes. They board from back to front (rows 30+) so we were among the first to board each time. Interior of the planes felt very new and sleek! Bigger than we expected especially as far as the legroom, but I still wouldn't wish it upon tall people. In fact the premium upgrade barely got you more room than you'd get at another Economy seat on other airlines (not quite worth it IMO!) We watched movies off a laptop, which a lot of other people seemed to do. For meals, we brought our own food and they even filled up our instant ramen cups with hot water for us! The hot meals were offered at a charge of over 40$ and they definitely did not seem worth it. Security on both ends let through a lot of packed food items, from what we could see on the trays of other passengers- we're talking full roasted chickens and mashed potatoes, etc. Extra detail - everything was in English which, from the comments overheard by francophone passengers was surprising considering it was a flight between Canada and France. Overall vastly exceeded expectations and worth the cheapo cost. But doesn't matter much now I guess!
reviews.author: PetitPrinceton

reviews.title: Game over
reviews.text: So my predictions only two days ago of the potential for major loss of money if you book with Primera have come true. I assume there is little chance of any of us getting any money back. We have lost $4700. It seems this airline cynically kept adding new flights and taking new bookings when they already knew they were about to go bust.
reviews.author: jimmy502018

reviews.title: Friendly Crew, but long flight with no T.V's!
reviews.text: Long flight, friendly crew, but no t.v's like other flights I have been on to help the flight go faster and make you feel more comfortable, especially if you don't like flying. But it was the cheapest flight we were able to find!
reviews.author: martinalyx935

reviews.title: Recommend
reviews.text: For a low budget airline I highly recommend primera air. Their seats are way bigger then Norwegian. Enough to comfort a 6+ hour trip.
reviews.author: samba0714

reviews.title: Trip to Paris
reviews.text: We upgraded to the Premium seats. The seats were comfortable and the service was very good. The price for the upgrade was the same as economy on the full price airlines.
reviews.author: Jim P

reviews.title: Clans and spacious aircraft.
reviews.text: Very clean aircraft and very good leg room. If you are not too bothered inflight entertainment and food then this is the best way to get yourself trans Atlantic at a budget. We packed our food and entertainment. Not to mention the staff were polite and child friendly. Will definitely fly again. Make sure you are at the departure gate well in advance.
reviews.author: Ashok S

reviews.title: Satisfied with solution - Cheap airline
reviews.text: Flight cancelled, options offered and despite the bad reviews, we received the refund within days. Fair enough would book with them again
reviews.author: Karel K

reviews.title: Stansted > Washington Dulles - would definitely fly with Primera Air again
reviews.text: Having read reviews on Trip Advisor and other review sites, I was a little apprehensive about flying with Primera Air. However when you look at the lower rating reviews more closely, their main basis seems to be one of cancellation at the last moment followed by difficulty in getting a new flight or a refund or compensation. Yes it is true that we had our first and our second flight cancelled – no reason given other than for operational reasons – but when you look at the number of seats available – I could only deduce that the reason was actually because not many seats had been sold. Also my flight were originally a Tuesday and then a Wednesday. We eventually were able to get a Thursday flight. As we are fairly regular fliers to Washington to visit family out there, we thought we would give Primera a go because their seats were about half the price of British Airways and living in Essex, Stansted is much closer than Heathrow. Accepting that there can be many frustrations with cancellations – this review mainly focuses on an actual flight with Primera. First off there is no online booking in facility so that means that you cannot print off a boarding pass – which can be frustrating if you only have carry on luggage. Their website advises to turn up about 3 hours before your flight – and this is the correct advice. There is no obvious permanent drop off area like there is for Ryan Air or Jet 2 – and when you arrive at Stansted you could wait for ages for the dropping off and board pass area to come up on the info board. Instead it is better to walk around and look for 1. A pop up info banner advertising upgrades to premium economy. 2 Look for the bright yellow crates that is used to measure your carry on luggage with, and 3 A small sign propped up on an empty desk. Then queue up behind these whilst waiting for the info board to change. That way you will be pretty near the front of the queue. When we flew the desk was B17 – but than cannot be any guarantee for the future. After that booking in was quite normal, very friendly and welcoming staff. Through security and then to the gate. Boarding was organised. Onto the plane which was brand new and spotless. The seats are a bit different to BA or Virgin in that they are thinner – and resemble a seat that the manager and substitutes sits in at a Premier League football. They do mould around your body though and are comfortable for an 8 hour flight. Flight staff were excellent and food was first class. If you can afford to upgrade to Premium Economy then go for it – even wide seats and masses of leg room. Would avoid Row 1 as the toilet queue at the front of the plane seem to always back up to those seats. Food is even better. If not travelling in Premium Economy – there is no 1st or Business Class - then you will have to pay for everything and that means everything – even water which you have to buy at £2 a bottle – no free tap water here. Even a blanket and a pillow will cost you. No on board entertainment but there is power sockets. In all – you have to be pretty organised to fly with Primera. Then on board costs are the same as the prices you would pay at an Airport restaurant or shop – but you can pack food and take it on board or even by a burger or other fats food and take it with you. People need to remember that no entertainment, no free drinks or free food means that prices are kept really low. Certainly a new way to travel from the UK to the USA – and you have to get your head around how Primera work- but it is a direct flight and with a bit of preparation it can work out much much cheaper. Now I have flown once with Primera – even though there were some difficulties with the original booking. I would have no hesitation in flying with them again on this route.
reviews.author: Frankiebloke

reviews.title: Great value; no amenities
reviews.text: Primera Air is an inexpensive option for getting to London's Stanstead airport (STN) on the way to other European destinations. Upgrading to an exit row seat is worth the small extra price, because otherwise you have to hope that you don't get a middle seat. The boarding/seating process is horrendous. If not enough people book, they will cancel the flight and you will have to wait two days until the next flight, because of their schedule. Bring food and a good book and you will be fine.
reviews.author: Kathy D

reviews.title: Stansted to New York
reviews.text: I've read many negative reports on here regarding Primera Air but it does its job. Stansted is 30 mins to my home so we thought we would give it a go. The plane was new, had plenty of legroom, was comfortable for the 7 hour flight, staff were polite and helpful. I'm not sure how long this service will last with all the extras that come with other companies? No TV, Meals not included, carry on luggage free all other cases must be paid for, You need to reserve seats if you want to be certain of sitting together. Personally i'd probably fly with BA, Virgin, Delta next time and pay for what i need. I think the total cost for return flights for a family of 4 adults was around £1600 which was good value for money considering. for this reason i wouldn't like to be too negative about Primera Air it's all still fairly new and i'm sure feedback will encourage change.
reviews.author: Gunflash

reviews.title: No issues at all
reviews.text: Having read some reviews of this airline I was somewhat sceptical of booking a trans Atlantic flight with them. I’ve flown on other so called budget airlines and a short flight isn’t an issue. I decided to go ahead and book my trip to Toronto which came in under £400 and also flew out of stansted which is the closest airport to me. From the booking to the flight itself all went very smoothly and I’d have no hesitation booking with them again. The no food on board wasn’t a problem as I planned ahead and brought my own food. The leg room was very good too as being 6 foot with long legs this is usually a bit of a squeeze. Lots of free seats on the out going flight, not so many on the way back to stansted but it was nice to have some extra room to stretch out and get some sleep. Flight crew on both flights were all very nice and helpful. All in all I think Primera are a well run airline and would have no hesitation booking again. Ps for a budget airline and a cost of under £400 return for a week in Toronto I am very happy with that trip!
reviews.author: paul213

reviews.title: Round trip - Paris/EWR
reviews.text: I had tortured myself with reading bad reviews after having booked the flight, but it turned out better than expected our flight departing for Paris was delayed by 1.5hrs but we still landed on time in Paris. The reason for the delay was that the incoming carrier was delayed in landing. The crew did a good job performing all their maintenance checks and cleaning the cabin quickly so we can board. We also had the opportunity to upgrade our seat at checking, we saw the sign and asked for two seats together, which they had available. The seats were roomy and comfortable, meal was good too. Our flight back from Paris to New York Newark was ok. This flight was on time, boarded and departed. We were meant to land an hour earlier but there was no where for us to land so we had to circle around for half hour. This is out of flight crew's control, but overall we dis land 30mins early. Again we upgraded to premium economy. Meal was good. My only issue with this flight was the lack of cabin crew veing able to control some rowdy passengers in premium economy. There were a few guys that were loud, annoying and kept making ruckus. I wish the cabin crew got them to stop. In addition, I think some of their friends came to sit in the empty seats in premium without paying the upgrade - this was really fruatrating....I paid money for comfort, not to be annoyed by jerks with the behavior of a 5yr old (though I'm sure 5yrs are better behaved).
reviews.author: Bisera E

reviews.title: Surprised by the good service
reviews.text: I paid very little for this flight and dident expect mutch . But I was surprised by the effectiveness and kind staf. Yes u have to be prepared to changes and the lack information ( they changed the gate ) . No problem with luggage at the check in . They did brake pretty hard at landing but a good flight for that low price (25€)
reviews.author: Lilysus89

reviews.title: High risk of losing a lot of money with this airline:  still owed $4700 nearly 3 months after cancellation.
reviews.text: Still owed promised $4700 by Primera after cancelled flight from Stansted to Newark in early July. As instructed the four of us booked alternative tickets home within their refund ceiling of Euros 1500 per passenger. On 9 August they promised refund within 4 weeks. No money and not even any response to numerous e mails since then. BE WARNED: THERE IS A REAL RISK OF LOSING A LOT OF MONEY IF YOU CHOOSE THIS AIRLINE.
reviews.author: jimmy502018

reviews.title: Know what you're buying and you'll be satisfied
reviews.text: For me this was exactly what I was looking for: to have myself treated as freight. All I wanted to pay for was the seat on the plane to ship my butt somewhere. I did not want a ticket that forces you to pay more than that to have things like in flight entertainment or wifi or food included. Just ship me where I want to go, that's all I'm here for. I think as long as you understand that your plane ticket covers literally only your seat you will be satisfied. If you want anything more than that seat expect to pay more. It is basically an a la cart plane ticket. You pay for the seat and then anything more than that (bags, meals, legroom, ability to pick a seat, etc) you can pay more for. You are not forced to subsidise other people's wants by paying a bloated prices that includes 10 different things in the price, half of which you don't want, need, or use. I admit the reviews from people with legitimate problems like the way Primera handles mechanical delays and cancellations are scary. And I was nervous right up until takeoff that something like that would happen. But I didn't have any delays or cancellations for my flight, so for me, this was a 5 star experience.
reviews.author: WhosWill

reviews.title: Calm and relaxing on time flight
reviews.text: I have read couple of very bad reviews on this airline, but to be honest, in my opinion it is just fine - the plane, the seats, boarding, cabin crew. Everything was just like any other airline. Would definitely fly again.
reviews.author: Dominik1505

reviews.title: Best Budget Airline
reviews.text: Although a budget airline, it is by far the best budget airline I have ever flown with. The leg room was greater than you usually get. Admittedly, we were apprehensive about flying with primera air as the flights were virtually half the price than alternative options. However, they only exceeded our expectations. Our only grumble is that the magazine's on board had not been switched from the previous flight. They were in a different language and items were priced in a foreign currency. However, the cabin crew apologised, explained that if they had taken the time to switch them the flight would have been delayed and were helpful in explaining the prices for common items over the speaker. Moreover, due to being a budget airline we were not supplied with a tunnel but had to take a bus.
reviews.author: Charlotte N

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Because I have only half a brain I booked my flight for the 29th instead of 28th ...I only realised 3 hours before the flight. I called there customer services who within minutes had changed the flight without charge as it was within a time limit and was over the moon with them. Check in easy. Great seats. Easy flight. Arrived early. All for 50£ with cabin baggage.would fly with them again without doubt Five 🌟
reviews.author: Kerry L

reviews.title: Great fares
reviews.text: The cars to Paris were AMAZING. I wasn't sure what to expect with this low cost carrier but I think people just need to understand that you are not going to get top notch service. For example they cancelled my return flight and it took multiple emails, calls and attempts to get closure on the resolution. Ultimately they put me on another carrier returning the next day... It works out fine but again you need to understand what you are paying for is what you get.
reviews.author: gfoodie2016

reviews.title: Small but great for the money
reviews.text: For the money I saved, I was happy except for the return. Paris Airport the plane was delayed more than 3 hours. They do not have a restaurant at Terminal 3, only a place to get cold sandwiches. Then they load you on a bus and you have to walk to the plane but I saved a lot of money and bought only a carry on.
reviews.author: eviek21

reviews.title: treated like a human
reviews.text: no online check in, but reasonably speedy at the desk. After that, no more queueing. Once the gate was announced, boarding started ( admitedly you sat on the plane for a while, but no standing or shuffling on stairs). We left on time and arrived early. Hand baggage could be checked in free but I didn't see anybody having their bags taken from them through lack of space. In all, a totally pleasant experience.
reviews.author: Brian H

reviews.title: All Around Excellent
reviews.text: I was skeptical about going on my flight after reading all the negative reviews on TripAdvisor; but we were pleasantly surprised at how all around wonderful both our outgoing and return flights were! All staff we encountered were extremely pleasant and helpful (on and off the aircraft)...special shout out to Oana who was the flight attendant on the Stansted to Newark leg of the flight. We travel quite often and she was the most caring and friendly flight attendant ever! There was plenty of leg room (bigger than any of the leading airlines' economy). The planes were clean and the seats were comfortable. I believe this is due to the design of the seats. We didn't pre-order any food, but purchased snacks at a reasonable price. There is no in flight entertainment, but this is not an issue as we have our own electronic devices. I am a very picky traveler and I will definitely be using Primera again.
reviews.author: Deborah T

reviews.title: 3 months and still waiting for compensation
reviews.text: Like many other travellers I am still waiting for the promised compensation of 1800 Euro's for my disaster of a journey to and from New York. I first wrote a review whilst sat in the departure lounge at Newark airport during a 10 hour delay. I sent my claim off 2 days after arriving back home to receive an immediate email saying that due to an unusual amount of claims my email should be answered within 30 days. More than 30 days later still no response. Another email sent to claims when I receive the same automated '30 days' email. After a further week I received a generic email which did not answer any of my questions but stated quite clearly that customer service is their priority. This email did confirm that I was due 600 Euro's compensation per passenger and could I provide all of my bank details, which I duly Did, along with a request to answer my original complaints. This email also stated that refunds could take up to 4 weeks to show in my bank account. 4 weeks came and went so I sent another email to once again receive the generic 30 day email. One week later I received another email saying that my claim was with the accounts department and could take anything up to 4 weeks. Are you kidding me???? This shouldn't be allowed!! There are hundreds of people who are waiting for compensation which this airline has to pay due to EU regulations. My worry is they will go bust before paying all passengers what they are due. Please see petition below which a disgruntled passenger has started on Change.org. This airline should not be allowed to get away with this symbolic service!!!!
reviews.author: MichSold

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: Originally Primera Air cancelled flights from Birmingham to Stansted which wasn't part of the plan and then reading all the bad reviews I really wasn't looking to flying with them, but I was pleasantly surprised by the service at the airport, the flight itself and the planes. The plane was comfy and staff were pleasant, the only thing that really let it down was no flight entertainment!
reviews.author: Claire36Bear

reviews.title: Keep away from this airline
reviews.text: Appalling service, flight out late, flight back cancelled. No apologies, treated like cattle. Does not abide by legal requirements to pay compensation. Ignores emails and cannot be contacted by phone. Don’t fly with this airline, you will be bitterly disappointed.
reviews.author: LoveSpain9999

reviews.title: Air travel
reviews.text: Much better than Ryan air. More leg room between seat rows. Staff very polite and friendly. Would travel with this air line again.
reviews.author: Anthony B

reviews.title: Good on all parts....
reviews.text: Good on all points when flying, both staffwise to the flight itself. The only thing that was a bit down was the page for online checkin didn´t work.
reviews.author: Ola A

reviews.title: Still Waiting... Getting Old
reviews.text: Writing this review in the line for check in as I have more than enough time to spare. 3 lines for one check in desk... Premiere employee management there! But hey! People just arrived! They turned up to work! NEWS FLASH! THEY HAVE MORE THAN ONE EMPLOYEE! Giving live coverage here in Alicante airport or maybe my grave if I'm left in this queue for much longer! Stansted won't know what hit them... In about 5 years time. These guys just strolled in without a care in the world. Amazing! To be that incompetent and see the queue but have the courage to make it into a Sunday stroll! Their mothers must be proud!
reviews.author: Sam W
